root_cause.text: The amdxdna driver's command slot handling functions performed a memset to zero the command header (npu_slot) before checking that the remaining slot space is at least as large as the header, causing an out-of-bounds write when the space is insufficient.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves `memset(npu_slot, 0, sizeof(*npu_slot))` after the size validation checks (`if (*size < sizeof(*npu_slot) + ...) return -EINVAL;`) in all four affected functions (aie2_cmdlist_fill_npu_cf, aie2_cmdlist_fill_npu_dpu, aie2_cmdlist_fill_npu_preempt, aie2_cmdlist_fill_npu_elf). The CVE description confirms this ordering flaw leads to out-of-bounds writes.

intent_record.intent_summary: Move memset after size validation to avoid zeroing output buffer on error.
intent_record.what: Moved the memset that zeros the npu_slot structure from before the size check to after the size check succeeds.
intent_record.how: Previously, if the size check failed, the function would still zero the npu_slot before returning an error. Now, the npu_slot is only zeroed when the size is sufficient and the function proceeds to write to it, preventing unnecessary memory clearing on error paths.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove redundant zeroing of npu_slot structure as it is already zero-initialized or fully overwritten before use.
intent_record.what: Removed a `memset` call that zeroed out the memory pointed to by `npu_slot` with size of the structure it points to.
intent_record.how: Before this change, `npu_slot` was explicitly zeroed before being used; after removal, any existing contents are preserved unless later overwritten by subsequent code.

intent_record.intent_summary: Zero-initialize the npu_slot structure before filling it to prevent potential use of uninitialized data in the NPU command submission.
intent_record.what: Added a memset call to zero-initialize the npu_slot structure before assigning its cu_idx field.
intent_record.how: Ensures all fields of npu_slot are cleared before use, preventing potential issues from stale or uninitialized data that could affect subsequent command submission.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove redundant zeroing of npu_slot structure, as it is already properly initialized elsewhere or the zeroing is unnecessary.

intent_record.how: Previously, the memory at npu_slot was cleared to zero before being filled; after this change, that memory is not explicitly zeroed, relying on prior initialization or assuming it is already zero.
